title: docs(deployment): the four-doors table spells the reference-integrity publish cell from its runtimeTypes and names the list-view field members
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLoVYr1D3xAegGzrSKBnTJB)_

domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyomgA6DeyZs4nPRcu

Fixes #30574

## What changes

One file, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, the four-doors table:

1. **Reference-integrity row.** The `runtime publish` cell read `✓ᶠ`. The `validateReferenceIntegrity` entry in `AUTHORING_RULES` declares `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'view', 'object', 'dataset', 'report', 'page']` on `origin/main` (f4d568ba), so the cell now reads `✓ᶠᵛᵒᵈᵗʳᵖ`, in the order the entry declares them. The row label now says that each write type runs only the members that declare it, and that the flow members named in the label stay on `flow` (`DEFAULT_MEMBER_RUNTIME_TYPES = ['flow']`).
2. **New row: list-view field members.** `validateSortableFields` (`['flow', 'view', 'page', 'object']`), `validateSearchableFields` (`['flow', 'view', 'object']`) and `validateListViewFieldRefs` (`['flow', 'view', 'object']`), measured in `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`. Cell `✓ᶠᵛᵒᵖ` (ordered so no adjacent pair reads as `ᵖᵒ` position), and the label says the `page` door runs the sort member only. The three CLI columns are `✓` because the entry's `commands` is `ALL`.
3. **Legend.** It had no code for `dataset` or `report`, which the entry declares. It now has `✓ᵈᵗ` `dataset` (two letters, because `dashboard` already holds `ᵈ`) and `✓ʳ` `report`, and the longest-first sentence names `ᵈᵗ`.

## Why

The legend says a rule's `runtimeTypes` is the authority. The old cell told an author that only a flow write is judged for reference integrity, while the view, object, dataset, report and page doors also refuse. No row named the list-view sort / search / field-reference members, so a reader could not see that a list-view sort on a `sortable: false` field is refused at publish.

## Verification

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Skills-docs: updated here

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 43 commands for this one path. I ran all 43 at 4fa47fad, after `turbo run build` over the `@objectstack/formula...`, `@objectstack/lint...` and `@objectstack/client-react...` closures (exit 0). All 43 exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` reports: 43 derived, 43 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Merging `origin/main` (b77c160a) did not touch this file, and the diff against `origin/main` is still this one file (+6 / -5). `check:commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` exits 0.

NOT MEASURED locally: the CI-only `Build Docs` and `Plan Test Core shards` steps, and the type-check lanes. Those belong to this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

Other rows in the same table also disagree with their rules' `runtimeTypes` on `origin/main`. This PR does not change them, because the claim's file surface is these two rows:

- CEL / predicate validation `✓ᶠ` vs `validateStackExpressions` `['flow','action','hook','object','view','page']`
- Dataset measure aggregate `—` vs `validateDatasetMeasureAggregates` `['dataset']`
- Ordering comparands `✓ᵈᵛᵒᵖᶠ` vs `validatePresetComparands`, which also declares `report`
- Empty filter combinators `✓ᶠ` vs `validateEmptyCombinators` `['flow','report']`
- Reference-integrity members that have crossed into rows whose cell says `—`: object & action name references (`validateObjectReferences` on `dataset`), chart bindings outside dashboards (`validateChartBindings` on `report`, `view`, `object`)

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI owns the repo-wide lint)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (docs only: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
